name: emit_domain_model
description: Emits the complete DomainModel (entities, operations, workflows, rules, gaps, glossary) extracted from the OpenAPI document. Use whenever the task is to model the target system's domain; call it once with the full model, and again in full if validation errors are returned.

name: decline_task
description: Returns a structured refusal to the Manager. Use instead of emit_domain_model only when the task asks for something other than a domain model (test scenarios, defect verdicts, prioritised bug lists, code) or the input is not an OpenAPI document.

input_schema.description: Structured refusal returned to the Manager.

requested.description: What the task asked for, in one sentence.

detail.description: Why a02 does not do it. Name no other agent; the Manager routes.
